properties.name: app.auth.issuer
properties.description: OAuth2 Authorization Server issuer URI (e.g. http://localhost:9000). Used as the `iss` claim and to build OIDC discovery/JWKS endpoints.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed CORS origins for the OAuth2/OIDC endpoints (/oauth2/**, /.well-known/**). Comma-separated list of scheme+host+port entries.

properties.name: app.clients.authorization-code.client-id
properties.description: Client id of the Authorization Code + PKCE client seeded on startup by DataInitializer.

properties.name: app.clients.authorization-code.client-secret
properties.description: Raw client secret of the Authorization Code client. Stored BCrypt-hashed in the registered client repository.

properties.name: app.clients.authorization-code.redirect-uri
properties.description: Allowed redirect URIs for the Authorization Code client (OAuth2 callback endpoints of the SPA/downstream services).

properties.name: app.clients.m2m.client-id
properties.description: Client id of the machine-to-machine (client_credentials) client seeded on startup by DataInitializer.

properties.name: app.clients.m2m.client-secret
properties.description: Raw client secret of the m2m client. Stored BCrypt-hashed in the registered client repository.

properties.name: grpc.user-service.host
properties.description: Host of the user-service gRPC server. Used by GrpcConfig to build the ManagedChannel for enriching access tokens with the user's displayName.

properties.name: grpc.user-service.port
properties.description: Port of the user-service gRPC server. Used by GrpcConfig to build the ManagedChannel for enriching access tokens with the user's displayName.
